name: Royal Enfield Himalayan 411
engine: 411 cc air/oil-cooled SOHC single, fuel injected
intro: A simple, slow adventure single. Most 2017-2021 bikes needed new brake calipers under recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2017-2021 Himalayans are in recall 23V129 because road salt can corrode the front and rear calipers. Dealers replace both calipers.
A-002.reason: Corroded calipers can cause a total loss of braking. The repair is free.

recalls.what: Road salt can corrode the brake calipers and cause a loss of braking.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces front and rear calipers free.
